title: C-SDLC editor cannot correct SIP scope after implemented review finding
body:
## Problem

An exact-head pre-PR review of #53 found a stale nonexistent path in SIP `declared_scope` after the issue had truthfully advanced to `implemented`. The typed `replace_planning_collection` operation is allowed for selected implemented-phase planning repairs but rejects SIP `declared_scope` with `sip mutation is not allowed during implemented`. This leaves no normal typed route to resolve a legitimate pre-publication review finding without hand-editing a card or using a locally patched editor.

## Acceptance criteria

- Provide an explicit typed pre-publication repair or recovery route for SIP `declared_scope` at `implemented`.
- Preserve stale-generation/digest, field ownership, rendered-card, and audit truth.
- Do not permit scope widening silently: require a reason and record old/new scope.
- Continue to reject scope changes after publication unless an explicit recovery transition has cleared publication/review truth.
- Add regression coverage for accepted pre-review correction and rejected post-publication mutation.

## Non-goals

- Do not weaken card ownership or permit direct Markdown edits.
- Do not change issue #53's receipt-contract scope.
